method: Per-year predictive marginal = piecewise-linear quantile function pinned to (p10, mean, p90) with slope-continued tails. Year-to-year dependence = Gaussian copula, AR(1) structure, rho = Pearson corr of consecutive-year z=Phi^-1(F_year(realized bWAR)) on the fit cohort. Total band = P10/P90 of N_SIM seeded simulated path sums (inverse-CDF sampling of the per-year marginals under the AR(1) copula). Estimation corpus is MLB-only (proj_eval/fa_projection), champion marcel_decay_v2, forward-chained (fit<=B-1, score complete seasons only).
scope_note: Dependence measured on the MLB vet corpus; applied to the continuous aging-quantile paths (vets + FA) produced by the same aging model. Prospect bucket paths (proj_export _prospect_rows) are a discrete career-trait mixture, a different statistical object with no realized FV->outcome corpus join; handling documented in the export change.
loss_ledger: C1 FAIL: simulated coverage 0.4055 is outside the [0.75,0.85] gate band. Root cause is NOT band width: the incumbent COMONOTONIC summed band (the widest admissible, rho->1) already covers only 0.6314 of realized multi-year totals, well below the 0.75 floor. It UNDER-covers, so the F-01 premise that the displayed band is 'too wide' does not hold against realized totals.

The summed band's misses are downside-dominated: 0.259 of realized totals fall BELOW its p10 (attrition -- players who leave the league realize ~0 WAR, below a strictly-positive decayed p10 path) vs 0.1097 above p90. The per-year quantile marginals carry no full-dropout zero floor, so the total band is MIS-CENTERED (too high), not too wide.

Coverage is monotone increasing in the copula rho and tops out at the comonotonic band: [(0.0, 0.2901), (0.2, 0.3486), (0.3451, 0.4084), (0.5, 0.4461), (0.7, 0.507), (0.9, 0.5852), (0.99, 0.6335)]. No admissible rho (<1) reaches 0.75; the mathematically-correct dependence fix (narrowing) moves coverage AWAY from the 0.80 target.

Even on the survived-all-window subset (n=1338, dropout-0 mass removed), the summed band covers only 0.5508 and the simulated 0.3685: the marginals undercover on rostered players too, so this is not solely an attrition artifact.

Disposition per R-BAND pre-registration: FAIL -> touch NO export code. The owner-approved fallback (drop the total P10-P90 bands from display) is a separate decision; the summed bands remain in the payloads unchanged. This gate result is evidence FOR that fallback: the displayed total bands are miscalibrated (undercover, mis-centered), and the dependence-correct replacement is narrower and therefore covers even less.
